limits: Native C/C++/asm library objects (*.a) only; all windows are dependency-tagged ("native-libraries", component "foundation") and award zero first-party credit.
Relocations are limited strictly to four-byte PC32/PLT32/GOTPCREL/GOTPCRELX/REX_GOTPCRELX and exact psABI gotpcrelx-mov-lea / gotpcrelx-call relaxations.

Native functions using x86-64 TLS GD->LE (R_X86_64_TLSGD, kind 19, ~600 KB in librocksdb-sys) or IE->LE (R_X86_64_GOTTPOFF, kind 22, ~136 KB in tikv-jemalloc-sys) linker relaxations are excluded under current unmodified tools/byte_progress.py rules.
Relocation fields are masked, not resolved; a match confirms exact Ubuntu GCC 13.3.0 reproduction of that function body from the candidate crate version(s).
